alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 10 at 11:22AM PDT until September 10 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures 97 to 103 and low temperatures 60 to 75
expected, with widespread Moderate HeatRisk and areas of Major
HeatRisk.

* WHERE...The central and southern Sacramento Valley, northern San
Joaquin Valley, Delta and Carquinez Strait, foothills, and portions
of the Coast Range.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses, especially to
anyone without effective cooling and/or adequate hydration.
alerts.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Lake Wind Advisory, west winds 20 to 25 mph with
gusts to 30 to 35 mph. For the High Wind Watch, southwest winds 20
to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph. Wind prone areas along I-580,
US-395, and the eastern slopes of the Carson Range may gust up to
60 to 70 mph.

* WHERE...For the Lake Wind Advisory, Washoe Lake. For the High Wind
Watch, the Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area.

* WHEN...For the Lake Wind Advisory, from 2 PM to 8 PM PDT Friday.

alerts.headline: Fire Weather Watch issued September 10 at 11:42AM PDT until September 13 at 12:00AM PDT by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
The National Weather Service in Reno has issued a Fire Weather
Watch for strong winds and low humidity, which is in effect from
Saturday morning through Saturday evening.

* Affected Area...Fire Weather Zone 420 Northern Sierra Front
including Carson City, Douglas, Storey, Southern Washoe,
Western Lyon, and Far Southern Lassen Counties, Fire Weather
Zone 421 Southern Sierra Front including Alpine, Northern
Mono, Southern Lyon, and Western Mineral Counties.

* Winds...Southwest 20 to 30 mph with
alerts.instruction:
Avoid outdoor activities that can cause a spark near dry
vegetation, such as yard work, target shooting, or campfires.
Follow local fire restrictions. Check weather.gov/reno for
updates and livingwithfire.info for preparedness tips.

alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued September 10 at 9:52AM PDT until September 10 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot late-season conditions expected with high
temperatures up to 112 to 116 in Death Valley and the Colorado
River Valley; up to 105 to 110 in the Las Vegas Valley, Moapa
Valley, and Pahrump Valley.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest Arizona, southeast California, and
southern Nevada.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT /8 PM MST/ this evening.

* IMPACTS...Heat-related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat.
alerts.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.
